subject: EOQ pilot sweetspot: one-time trial boost for QuickScale
messages:
From: Aditi Mehra <aditi@quickscale.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Ravi Singh <ravi@quickscale.ai>, procurement@quickscale.ai
Date: 2027-09-25T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: QuickScale pilot — request for short-term trial expansion

Hey Karthik,

Hope you’re well — we’re about to kick a pilot of Redwood across two internal teams (search and support routing) and the initial results look promising. I pulled a quick usage snapshot (attached) and we’re close to hitting the cap on the free trial.

Given this is EOQ for us, leadership asked whether Redwood can provide a one-time trial boost (additional credits or a short extension) so we can complete the evaluation and make a purchase decision this quarter. The ask is modest: an extra 300k tokens or a 14-day extension.

If this is feasible, we can confirm a PO quickly — procurement is standing by. Let me know what approval steps you need on your end.

Thanks,
Aditi
Aditi Mehra
Head of ML Ops, QuickScale
Attachments: qs_usage_snapshot.csv (CSV, 42KB)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-25T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: QuickScale pilot — request for short-term trial expansion

Forwarding QuickScale's ask — they need a one-time boost to finish evaluation and will sign/PO if we can accommodate. Key details: 300k extra tokens OR 14-day extension; related deal QS-2027-1734; potential PO within 48 hours.

Vanessa — can we approve a micro-subsidy? Suggestion: provide a 300k token credit scoped to the pilot models (gpt-small-open variants) and mark it as one-time non-recurring. Ben, will this fit within the Q3 pilot credit budget or do you need a paper trail?

Monica — if we greenlight, any operational caveats we should note (KV cache retention, rate limits)?

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-25T12:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: QuickScale pilot — request for short-term trial expansion

Karthik — thanks for the context. I’m supportive of a targeted one-time credit for closeable pilots, especially when procurement is ready to PO. Proposed approval: 300k token credit, valid for 30 days, limited to the pilot project (QuickScale account), and revocable if abused. I’ll need Ben to confirm the dollar-equivalent and sign-off from finance.

Also include a small success checklist for them to complete (1. share eval criteria, 2. agree to PO cadence, 3. 30-day feedback call). Monica — can you draft the checklist and any onboarding notes?

Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Director, MidMarket Sales
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-25T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QuickScale pilot boost — finance OK for microcredit

Team — finance is ok to approve a one-time credit up to $1,200 USD net for pilots under our EOQ conversion program. 300k tokens for the models they're using maps to roughly $1,100 at current rates, so this fits. Conditions: require procurement email confirming intent to PO (provided they sign within 30 days), and we should attach an approval doc for legal/audit.

I’ll prepare an approval PDF (redwood_oneoff-credit-approval.pdf) and send it once Karthik confirms the scope.

Ben Carter
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Aditi Mehra <aditi@quickscale.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-26T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QuickScale pilot — onboarding checklist + next steps

Hi Aditi — quick checklist and logistics from CS to ensure the additional credit is used for evaluation and not long-term consumption:

- Share the evaluation criteria (KPIs you’ll grade the models on)
- Confirm which model variants & endpoints we should scope the credit to (please flag any heavy-batched jobs)
- Agree to scheduling a 30-day wrap-up call with product + CS
- Procurement email confirming intent to issue PO within 30 days (to unlock the credit)

Once we get procurement confirmation, finance will drop the one-time credit and legal will attach the approval doc. Attaching the proposed MOP (method of proceeding) for quick review.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: qs_proposed-mop.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Aditi Mehra <aditi@quickscale.ai>, procurement@quickscale.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-29T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QuickScale pilot — approved one-time trial boost

Hi Aditi / QuickScale team — good news: finance has approved a one-time, non-recurring credit equivalent to 300,000 tokens (approx. $1,100 USD) for your pilot. Conditions and next steps below:

- Credit details: 300,000 token credit, valid 30 days from issuance, applicable only to the pilot account and model endpoints listed in the attached MOP.
- Conditions: procurement must send an email confirming intent to issue a PO within 30 days; credit will be revoked if we detect non-pilot usage patterns (we’ll flag before revocation).
- Paper trail: attaching redwood_oneoff-credit-approval.pdf (approval id: RW-EOQ-2027-432). Legal has signed off on the one-off approval form.
- Ops: Monica will onboard your SRE for KV/cache tuning and rate limit guardrails so the credit isn’t burned on background jobs.

Aditi — please reply-all with procurement’s confirmation and I’ll trigger the credit issuance. If procurement needs a formal invoice or PO wording, loop Ravi and we’ll provide a template.

Congrats on getting this over the line — looking forward to closing the PO.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_oneoff-credit-approval.pdf (PDF, 14KB)
